name: Global Leaders Corp
summary: Global Leaders Corporation (GLCP), operating through its various subsidiaries, specializes in providing bespoke consulting and professional development programs. Its primary focus is on assisting management executives of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) located in Hong Kong. Beyond its local operations, the company also extends its expertise across the Asia-Pacific region, offering vital advisory and comprehensive corporate guidance to emerging start-up businesses and budding entrepreneurs. GLCP was established in 2020 and is headquartered in Wanchai, Hong Kong.
